description: Pet-centric ranged spec - fights two bodies at once, splits incoming damage across the hounds, and builds Focus off its own auto-attacks.
_source_note: Built from reference/coa_sidekick/SPEC_witch-hunter__houndmaster.txt and the houndmaster spec tree in reference/coa_sidekick/talents/witch-hunter.json. CoA calls it 'a Survival-Hunter chassis with a heavier pet emphasis'. THE STRUCTURAL LIMIT on this spec: CoA's hound stack is a permanent Shadowhound plus temporary lesser hounds from Unleash the Hounds, Kennel Master and Daredevil, and Frontier keeps exactly ONE active pet - a second summon replaces the first. So every 'more hounds' talent is redirected into the three pet keys the engine really reads (pet_damage, pet_health, pet_armor), which makes this one strong hound rather than a pack. The Intellect nodes are not decoration: CoA's stat priority puts Intellect fourth, above Spell Power, because Shadewalker and Dark Mind both convert it.

nodes.name: Dark Ranger
nodes.description: Increases your hound's damage by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the Shadow damage dealt by your Shadow Hounds by 5%.' pet_damage is one of the three keys Pet deliberately reads off its owner's talents when it is built, and a FRACTION (0.06 is the shipped value in Stormbringer Wind and Primalist Wildwalker).

nodes.name: Expert Shot
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Shadowblast by 5% and grants 1 hit rating per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Shadowblast by 10% and your hit chance by 2%.' Hit leads this spec's stat priority too.

nodes.name: Houndfeeder
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical strike chance of you and your Shadow Hound by 4%.' A pet has its own crit_chance off its template and there is no pet_crit key, so only the owner's half is real.

nodes.name: Hail of Gunfire
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 2 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your ranged haste by 10%.' Same ranged_haste gap as Boltslinger's Rapid Reload.

nodes.name: Kennel Master
nodes.description: Increases your hound's health by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Unleash The Hounds now has a 25% chance to summon an additional Lesser Shadow Hound for 15 seconds.' The engine keeps ONE pet, so a second hound is impossible; what the extra body bought was more hound to go round, which pet_health delivers honestly.

nodes.name: Silver Bullets
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Darkslayer by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Darkslayer by 10%, increased by an additional 10% against Undead.' No creature-type hook, so the flat half only.

nodes.name: Darkrider
nodes.description: Reduces the Focus cost of your abilities by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the Rage cost of Shadowblast, Vault, and Unleash the Hounds by -10.' Shadowblast and Vault are already free in Frontier (they are the builders), so a three-ability flat cut would mostly hit nothing - it discounts the whole book instead.

nodes.name: Trapper
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Shadow Trap and Death Trap by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cooldown of your Trap spells by -25%', with the class tree's Three Sevens and Trap Card extending them. Trap duration is not a thing - a Frontier trap is cast, not placed - so only the cooldown half survives.

nodes.name: Loksey's Journal
nodes.description: Increases your hound's damage by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Shadow Rage by 20% of your ranged attack power.' Shadow Rage is a hound buff, so scaling it is scaling the hound. A pet cannot read its owner's attack power (Pet deliberately does not inherit the owner's stats or gear), so this is flat pet damage.

nodes.name: Rampaging Hounds
nodes.description: Increases the damage your abilities deal to additional targets by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Shadow Hounds melee attacks now cleave 1 additional nearby enemy.' A pet's targeting is not talentable, so the cleave lands on the Houndmaster's own AoE.

nodes.name: Defender of Darkshire
nodes.description: Increases your hound's armor by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critical strikes with ranged auto attacks now increase the melee haste of your Shadow Hounds by 10% for 5 seconds.' There is no pet_haste key, and the spec's whole premise is splitting damage across hounds, so the third live pet key carries this node instead.

nodes.name: Scent of Magic
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Houndmaster's Call by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critical strikes now apply Scent of Magic for 15 seconds, causing your Shadow Hound's next Shadow Leap to incur a -10 sec reduced cooldown.' Houndmaster's Call is Frontier's version of the hound leap, so the reduction lands there.

nodes.name: Decimate
nodes.description: Increases your hound's damage by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Empowers your Shadow Hounds for 20 seconds, granting them 30% increased damage and haste and allowing them to ignore Armor.' The ABILITY of the same name keeps the Houndmaster's burst window; this node is the permanent hound damage, which is the only half a pet can receive.

nodes.name: Pure Agony
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike damage of Quickdraw by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical damage of Quickdraw by 50%.' ability_<id>_crit_damage is a real per-ability key, read in _crit_damage_bonus.

nodes.name: Reload
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Quickdraw by 1 turn.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cooldown of Quickdraw by -4 sec.' Quickdraw is a 2-turn cooldown, and talented_cooldown floors at 1, so one rank is all there is room for.

nodes.name: Anguish
nodes.description: Increases your Shadow spell damage by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Shadow damage dealt now has a 5% chance to reduce the channel time of your next Darkflock by -50%.' Channel time is not modelled; Darkflock is the spec's one spell-power cast, so the node raises the school it deals in. shadow_spell_damage is built at runtime as f'{school}_spell_damage' - another family a literal scan would call dead.

nodes.name: Shadewalker
nodes.description: Grants attack power equal to 3% of your Intellect per rank.
nodes._source: CoA stat priority: 'Intellect (Shadewalker converts Int into AP and Dark Mind converts Int into crit rating)'. A real conversion, resolved against the shared STAT_CONVERSION maps in character.py. No other ranged spec in the game wants Intellect; these two nodes are why this one does.

nodes.name: Dark Mind
nodes.description: Grants critical strike chance equal to 2% of your Intellect per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your critical strike rating by 25% of your Intellect.' The other half of the Intellect pair.

nodes.name: Daredevil
nodes.description: While below 35% health, you take 6% less damage per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'When you take damage that would reduce your health to 35% or less, you summon 3 lesser Shadow Hounds and reset the cooldown of Vault', described as 'the main safety net' and 'the emergency bail-out'. Neither the extra hounds nor the reset is expressible, so the engine's own low-health mitigation pair carries it - at CoA's own 35% threshold.

nodes.name: Lethal Pursuit
nodes.description: Increases your hound's damage by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Shadow Rage now also grants your Shadow Hounds 10% increased haste and it now stacks 3 additional times.' pet_haste does not exist; stacking does not either. The throughput does.

nodes.name: Veiled in Darkness
nodes.description: Increases your attack power by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'A veil of dark magic encircles you at all times, granting 5% increased Attack Power to party and raid members within 100 yds', which is what the spec's raid rating is sold on. A talent cannot grant a party aura - talent effects only ever apply to their own character - so the Houndmaster keeps it. The real party-facing buffs in this class are abilities (Slayer, Monster Hunting).

nodes.name: Expulsion of Evil
nodes.description: Your ranged attacks have a 15% chance to reset the cooldown of Houndmaster's Call.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Direct ranged attacks and abilities now have a 5% chance to reset the cooldown of Houndmaster's Call.' reset_cooldown IS a real proc payload - the one cooldown reset the engine can actually do - so this node is CoA's exactly, at a higher chance because a turn is longer than a cast.

nodes.name: Deal With the Devil
nodes.description: Everything you and the hounds land hits harder, and everything costs more.
nodes._source: Capstone. CoA: 'Your and your Shadow Hounds critical damage dealt with Shadow damage is increased by 50%, but the cost of your spells and abilities is increased by 25%.' The real drawback is kept - all_ability_cost_pct POSITIVE is a cost increase, and it is the only node in this class that charges you for itself.
